semanticResolutions.decision: Merge Just Goods and SoL's disjoint cloves injections.
semanticResolutions.reason: Just Goods injects only the cloves default_market_price while SoL injects demand_add and wealth_impact_threshold. These database-entry injections affect distinct fields, so both active mods' behavior is retained without a Concordia replacement.

semanticResolutions.decision: Keep CMF and SoL callback registrations while excluding MRC's CMM callback.
semanticResolutions.reason: EU5 merges same-named on-action definitions from different files. The content-checked MRC replacement suppresses only MRC's CMM callback; CMF's core handler and SoL's independent handler remain active.

semanticResolutions.decision: Keep the CMF, Just Goods, and SoL registration callbacks; exclude MRC's CMM registration.
semanticResolutions.reason: EU5 merges same-named on-action definitions from different files. Just Goods and SoL register distinct settings through CMF; the content-checked MRC replacement disables MRC's CMM registration.

semanticResolutions.decision: Retain the independent monthly pulse registrations.
semanticResolutions.reason: EU5 natively merges same-named on-action definitions from different files. CMF, Just Goods, and SoL register distinct monthly callbacks; no shared definition needs to be replaced.

semanticResolutions.decision: Retain all independent game-start callbacks and MRC historical defaults.
semanticResolutions.reason: EU5 natively merges same-named on-action definitions from different files. The MRC replacement retains safe-default initialization while removing only its CMM hooks; CMF, Just Goods, and SoL callbacks remain separate.

semanticResolutions.decision: Retain the independent yearly pulse registrations.
semanticResolutions.reason: EU5 natively merges same-named on-action definitions from different files. CMF, Just Goods, and SoL yearly callbacks and event pools are distinct contributions.

semanticResolutions.decision: Keep CMF as the shared log-state owner and retain SoL as a producer.
semanticResolutions.reason: SoL uses CMF's log key allocator and maps, applies the same 200-entry cap, and increments cmf_log_count once per entry. Both writers implement the same CMF log contract rather than competing state.

semanticResolutions.decision: Merge on_game_load callbacks additively: retain CMF callbacks and MRC safe-default initialization.
semanticResolutions.reason: The built mod retains each package's on_actions registration in separate files; MRC's initialization restores its default values without exposing CMM controls.
